text:
UAB men's soccer to open 2026 season at home against Lipscomb
L. V. Thayer
The UAB men's soccer team will begin its 2026 campaign on Aug. 20 against Lipscomb at PNC Field in Birmingham, with kickoff scheduled for 7 p.m. This is the fifth time in the last six seasons that UAB has opened its season at home.
UAB will host a total of 10 home games during the upcoming season, with five of its first six matches being played at PNC Field. Fans can watch the game on ESPN+ or follow live stats online.
In series history, UAB holds a 4-1-2 all-time record against Lipscomb. The most recent meeting between the teams occurred in 2019 and ended in a 1-1 double-overtime draw in Birmingham. UAB won the first three meetings between the programs in 2007, 2010, and 2012.
The athletic department also announced that the 2026-27 Gold Card is now on sale, granting access to all home events for women's soccer, men's soccer, volleyball, women's basketball, softball, and baseball (Regions Field & Young Memorial), though it does not include entry to American Athletic Conference or NCAA Championship events.
Support through sport-specific gift accounts continues to play an important role for UAB student-athletes by providing resources for recruiting, nutrition, student-athlete development, and technology. For more information about supporting UAB Athletics or following updates from the men's soccer team throughout the season, fans are encouraged to visit official channels.
